bounded_scope: Checked official reference branch, SP PR2057 files/comments, known Bigv2 release and current SP chestnut catalog plus release list. No claim to exhaust private/unpublished artifacts.
compilation_requirement: Existing pinned native compiler executes source and reloaded graph against a real matching AMD target to produce its successful verification report. This CPU-only cloud workspace has no AMD/USB device. Mock execution previously failed its lifted CPU ushort2-to-float4 bitcast kernel; no verified AMD artifact resulted.
off_vehicle_option: A maintainer/CI machine with a matching physical AMD LLVM gfx1200 USB/Chestnut target and the pinned runtime can build once using existing compile_modeld_v2.py, publish the SPTG plus complete source/reload provenance and exact hashes, then the installed device only performs a short inference check. An arbitrary AMD PCI target does not meet the current USB-target admission contract. No such public package was found. Hosted CPU-only CI cannot truthfully claim the compiler source/reload physical execution check.
